name: The Dead Star's Light
summary: Hunger of Hadar once per long rest, and resistance to radiant damage. The price: Constitution -2, vulnerability to fire, and a corpse-light no hood can hide.

source.note: A vestige of the Amber Temple (Curse of Strahd chapter 13 in spirit). The vestige's name is the book's; the gift, its benefit, its price and every word here are ours, designed for this game. Found in amber_temple_vault (the hall of vestiges).

benefit.text: Light that gives no warmth runs under your skin. Once a day you can open a hole into the cold between the stars.

cost.flaw: Your skin is cold to the touch and gives off a faint grey glow in the dark. You will never hide at night again.
cost.text: A dead star burns cold, and its ashes catch easily.
